items.prompt: Which reference is genuinely independent of this price kernel?

options.text: The same function called under a new name
Only parity imposed by the same code
options.why: That is useful but not an independent oracle.
Its assumptions and tolerances still need review.

options.text: The same normal-CDF helper and price formula copied into a second wrapper
options.why: A copied implementation can retain the same defects; the independent integral reference must not call that kernel.

items.explanation: Different wrappers do not create independent validation.
